name: kb_demote
description: Downgrade KB entry confidence one rung: CONFIRMED -> INFERRED -> UNVERIFIED. UNVERIFIED entries are a no-op. This is the "I am now LESS certain" path, not the "this claim is wrong" path. Requires a reason (at least 20 characters stating what you checked); evidence_files is optional -- omit it when the demotion has nothing new to cite. Appends a demotion note to content as an evidence trail. Guidance: less certain -> kb_demote; proven wrong -> kb_feedback or kb_resolve_contradiction (NOT kb_invalidate, which only touches context-cache rows). Returns {id, previous_confidence, new_confidence}.
